purpose: Measure correction of the confirmed post-2026-07-26 player-history gap, separately from current official roster information, under unchanged trained models.
registration_scope: Old 709 and 193 outcomes are already known. This is a retrospective data-quality diagnostic, registered before repaired inputs and predictions.
supplement_commit_and_hash: Must be pinned after ready-for-join handoff; never consume changing working outputs.
cohort: The same 709 physical fixtures of the prior full official-information experiment; no performance-based additions or deletions.
source_quality_levels: repaired prior-only selectors, complete player numeric observations, and same-unit relief-outs histories
old_four_settings: Reuse the existing frozen artifacts, unchanged.
new_four_settings: Regenerate prior selectors by the same latest-unique-lineup and last-five-distinct-starters rules, using only earlier calendar-day official records. Apply the same original scalar formulas with repaired lagged observations.
history_policy: Keep confirmed zero values distinct from missing values.
For batting use only direct or exactly justified AB,H,BB observations; BB+HBP is never pure BB. Preserve incomplete observations separately.

Window numeric components on the last ten complete observed appearances, including recorded zero-PA appearances; retain exact game/date/identity evidence. Do not silently replace unknown BB with zero.
For starters require ER and outs from prior games with correct innings conversion.

Use the original relief-outs proxy definition, not pitch counts substituted into its numeric scale. Aggregate relief workload may use source-validated team pitching records even if some non-starter IDs are missing.
Resolve duplicates and identity conflicts by fixed provenance rules, never realized return.
Never include target, same-date or future game numeric results. Keep real receipt times and explicit previous-calendar-day completion assumptions.
Do not change team/rest/park features or unrelated fields.
source_missing_policy: Partial verified coverage is acceptable but must retain nulls and report component-usable freshness, not just the date of any captured row.
evaluation: Freeze repaired predictions in Git before scoring.
Use identical prices, products, tie order, refunds and cohorts for all source-quality and current-information settings.
Report full 709, old 193, new 516, and pre-gap versus post-gap groups with their overlapping nature explicit.
Report all settings, probability loss, changes, accuracy, unit ROI including refund stakes, weekly paired uncertainty and coverage.
Do not select an operating winner by inspected test performance.
limitations: Currently retrieved historic records do not establish actual pregame receipt or exact executable prices.
The fixed model was trained on projected information; this is not a newly trained optimal official-player model.
